notes.title: Version 1.3.8 - Aiming Update is out now!
notes.content:
Based on the variety of feedback I've received since releasing on Steam last week, I decided to make some slight changes to the aiming system in the game and add some options for customizing the aiming to your preference!

New in this update:
[list]
[*]Fixed weirdness when aiming close to the player with mouse + keyboard.
[*]Decreased the default impact on camera position from aiming.
[*]Added the following options to the Options Menu:
[list]
    [*]Camera Aim Impact - The amount the camera moves based on aiming.
    [*]Controller Aim Speed - The speed that the aiming cursor moves when using a controller.
    [*]Controller Remember Aim - Toggles whether to keep the cursor aimed in the last direction aimed by the controller. This is a new feature that is enabled by default.
[/list]
[*]Other small UI tweaks and bug fixes.
[/list]

Hope these additions are helpful to the players who were having some trouble! Let me know what you think! :)
